name: Katsuragi Ariko
source:
The main character.

An open-minded girl who finds herself getting attached to strange types like the Cheshire Cat.

She tends to direct her thoughts inward, which worries people around her sometimes. But she doesn't seem to be worried, content with the world she created for herself.

She could probably do with a bit more worrying.

[From in-game profile]
